items.name: mithaq-copy

items.name: mithaq-refusal

items.name: mithaq-field-values

items.name: mithaq-choice-control

items.name: mithaq-checkbox-control

items.name: mithaq-default-components

items.name: mithaq-list-pagination

items.name: mithaq-list-types

items.name: mithaq-list-toolbar
items.title: Mithaq list toolbar

items.name: mithaq-use-list-state

items.name: mithaq-list-header
items.title: Mithaq list header

items.name: mithaq-list-dialogs

items.name: mithaq-screens-host
items.title: Mithaq screens host
items.description: What a TanStack Start app draws every screen with: the server functions that resolve the actor, the access report and the screen, the frame and the page each generated route file hands its screen's glob to, the list read through TanStack Query off its qs URL, the form's landing after a save and its guard on leaving with a change, the fetch plug's client, the /unauthorized route, the public landing page at /, the language switch its header and the app's auth pages draw, and the frame, boxes and password toggle those auth pages share. Nothing in it names a screen; `mithaq generate screens` writes each screen's glob and route files beside it. What it imports from the app, which no item writes: `localeOf`, `locales`, `refusalKey` and the type `Locale` from `src/copy.ts`; `wanted` from `src/redirect.ts`; `useCopy` from `src/routes/__root.tsx`, whose route context names the app's own copy key as `app`; `NoOrganization` from `src/no-organization.tsx`, what `/unauthorized` draws for someone in no organization; the project as the package `asas`; `mithaq-admin/form.tsx`, the installed package. The app's `createRouter` spreads `flatSearch` from `src/screen-list.tsx`, so the router reads and writes the list's URL pairs as strings.

items.name: mithaq-storage
items.title: Mithaq storage
items.description: The storage adapters a project owns, S3 with an R2 preset, UploadThing for reading and deleting files already there, and a local folder, and the eight functions the storage rukn's config names: the object key, the verification of a stored file, its disposition, the sweep of orphans, and the upload flow's instructions, create step, delete step and file route.

items.name: mithaq-mail

items.name: mithaq-expected-updated-at
items.title: Mithaq expectedUpdatedAt step
items.description: A write step that refuses an update with a 409 when the row's updatedAt is not the instant the caller read, compared against the row the runner locked inside the update's transaction. A kayan adds it by widening its update input with an expectedUpdatedAt and listing the step before the store step.

items.name: mithaq-directional-icon

items.description: A wrapper that mirrors the icon inside it in a right-to-left page, so the pager's chevrons point the way the page reads. No shadcn registry serves it under a bare name, so this registry ships it.
